research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Heart Aerospace is developing a method of managing conditioning fluid of a thermal management system for an aircraft, alongside an aerospace thermal management system for a hybrid electric aircraft that cools electric propulsion units via multiple fluid circuits. They also work on an aerospace electric propulsion thermal management system with coordinated motor and power electronics cooling, an energy distribution system for prioritizing aircraft electrical loads, systems for charging and redistributing power in multi powertrain aircraft, and a modular thermal management system. Together these focus on thermal control, electric propulsion, power distribution, charging and powertrain integration.

overview_description.description:
Heart’s mission is to create the fastest, most affordable and sustainable transportation for regional travel to every corner of the world.
Their first aircraft is the ES-19, a nineteen-passenger airliner with an operating range of 400 km. Heart's goal is to have the aircraft certified for commercial operation by 2026.
